name: 1. Create patient profile (form-data)

form.name: condition
form.value: Type 1 diabetes. Carries an insulin pen in her bag. Risk of hypoglycaemia.

docs:
Creates a patient profile and asks Claude to generate bystander instructions.

All six text fields are required by middleware/validate.js:
  name                        2-80 chars
  condition                   5-1000 chars
  language                    "en" or "ar" (optional, defaults to en)
  emergencyContact[name]      2-80 chars
  emergencyContact[phone]     phone number
  emergencyContact[relation]  2-40 chars
  photo                       required image file

The photo field points at test-assets/sample-photo.png in this repo.
Swap it for any image you like.

Copy `user.id` from the 201 response into request 2.

name: 2. Trigger emergency (JSON)
docs:
Paste the `user.id` returned by request 1 into `userId`.

It must be a 24-character MongoDB ObjectId, otherwise validate.js rejects
the request with 400 before it reaches the controller.

Note: the in-memory database is wiped every time you restart the server,
so re-run request 1 after each restart to get a fresh id.
